field.label: Use Magento Search Synonyms
field.comment: Sends the groups from Marketing > SEO & Search > Search Synonyms to Meilisearch. This replaces any synonyms set on the Indices page, so move those to Magento first. When turned off, the synonyms on the index stay as they are and can be edited on the Indices page.

field.label: Search Category Names
field.comment: Matches products on the names of their categories and parent categories, ranked straight after the product name. Best left off when categories have names like "Sale" or "New In" that would match unrelated searches. Needs a full reindex.
